lines: Hi, good afternoon, I'm calling from the cards team at your bank about your monthly statement.
Your statement balance this month is five hundred and twelve dollars, and the payment due date is the eighteenth.
If you've already paid, please ignore this call, it can take a day or two to show.
You can pay through your banking app, at any AXS station, or set up GIRO so you don't miss it.
We won't ask you for any card details or one-time password on this call.
Alright, thank you for your time, have a nice evening.
Hello, may I speak to Mr Lim? I'm calling from the home loans department.
This is just a courtesy reminder that your mortgage instalment will be deducted on the first of next month.
Please make sure there's enough balance in your linked savings account by then.
There's nothing else you need to do, the deduction is automatic.
If you'd like to change the deduction account, you can visit any branch with your IC.
Okay, thank you Mr Lim, goodbye.
Good morning, this is Rachel from the credit card collections team.
Our records show the minimum payment for last month's statement hasn't come in yet.
The minimum amount is fifty dollars, and a late fee may apply if it's not paid by Friday.
You can make the payment yourself in the app or internet banking, whichever is easier for you.
Please don't give your card number or PIN to anyone who calls, including us.
Oh, you paid it this morning? Sorry for the trouble then, have a good day.
Hello, this is the fraud monitoring team from your bank. I'm calling about a card transaction.
There was an online purchase of one hundred and ninety dollars at an electronics store about an hour ago.
Was that you? You can just answer yes or no, I don't need any other details.
Okay, thanks for confirming. Since it was you, there's nothing more to do and your card stays active.
For your safety, we will never ask you to transfer money or read out an OTP.
Have a good evening.
Good evening, I'm calling from your bank's card security team about some unusual activity.
We stopped a payment attempt of eight hundred dollars from an overseas website this afternoon.
If you don't recognise it, I can block the card now and a new one will be mailed to your registered address.
Alright, the card is blocked. Your money is safe and the payment did not go through.
You don't need to give me any codes or passwords, and you don't need to move any money.
The replacement card should arrive in five to seven working days. Thank you.
Hi, this is a call from your bank regarding an alert on your account.
We sent you a notification in the app asking you to confirm a new device login from this morning.
Please open the app yourself when convenient and tap whether it was you.
If it wasn't you, the app will guide you to lock your account, or you can call the hotline on our website.
I won't ask for your login details or any code over the phone.
Thank you, goodbye.
Hello, I'm calling from the bank to let you know your replacement debit card has been posted.
It should reach your mailbox within the week.
When it arrives, you can activate it in the banking app under card services.
Your old card will stop working once the new one is activated.
Remember, no one from the bank will ask you for the PIN or the code we send you.
That's all from me, thank you.
Good morning, this is the Tampines branch calling about your appointment to update your account details.
We have you down for Thursday at two p.m. with our customer service officer.
Please bring your NRIC and a recent proof of address, like a utility bill.
The update usually takes about twenty minutes.
If you need to reschedule, you can do it through the appointment page in the app.
See you on Thursday, bye.
Hello, this is a short service call from your bank, it's about scam awareness.
We're reminding customers that scammers are pretending to be bank staff and police officers.
Real bank staff will never ask you to move money to a safe account or share your one-time password.
If anyone asks you to do that, just hang up and call our official hotline yourself.
There's nothing you need to do now, your account is fine.
Thank you for your time and stay safe.
Hi, I'm following up on the suspicious SMS you reported to us yesterday.
Thank you for forwarding it. We've confirmed it was a phishing message and not from us.
We have reported the link so it can be taken down.
Since you didn't click it or enter any details, your account is safe.
Just a reminder, we never send links asking you to log in or update your card.
Thanks again for reporting it. Goodbye.
Hello, this is customer service from your mobile operator about your latest bill.
Your bill for this month is sixty-eight dollars and it's due on the fifteenth.
It's a bit higher because of the roaming charges from your trip last week.
You can see the breakdown in the app, and pay there or through GIRO.
If you'd like a roaming plan for next time, I can send you the details by SMS.
Okay, thank you, have a good day.
Hi, good afternoon, I'm calling from your broadband provider. Your two-year contract ends next month.
We have a renewal offer that keeps your current speed at thirty-nine dollars a month.
There's no need to decide now, you can renew in the app or at any of our shops.
If you don't renew, the service just continues at the normal monthly rate.
I'll send the offer to your email so you can read it first.
Thank you, have a good evening.
Hello, this is the utilities customer service team calling about your electricity and water account.
Your last bill of one hundred and twenty dollars is a few days overdue.
We just wanted to remind you before the next bill comes, there's no disconnection at this stage.
The app, internet banking or any AXS machine will all work for the payment.
If you're having difficulty, we can arrange a payment plan with you.
Alright, thank you, goodbye.
Good morning, I'm calling from the town council office about your service and conservancy charges.
Our system shows two months of charges outstanding, about one hundred and sixty dollars in total.
You can pay at our office counter, by GIRO, or through the AXS machines.
If you've already arranged GIRO recently, it may not have started yet.
Our office is at the void deck of block two-one-five, open till six.
Okay, thank you for your time.
Hello, this is Daniel from your insurance company's customer care team.
I'm calling because the annual premium for your travel and home policy is due at the end of the month.
The amount is two hundred and thirty dollars, the same as last year.
You can pay through our customer portal or by cheque, the details are in the letter we mailed you.
If you'd like to cancel instead, just let your agent know, there's no penalty.
Thank you, have a nice day.
Hi, I'm calling from the claims department about the hospital claim you sent in last month.
We still need the official hospital receipt before we can continue processing it.
You can upload the receipt on our customer portal, or post it to the address in our letter.
Once we have it, the result usually takes about ten working days.
Any payout goes to the bank account you registered with us, so you don't need to give bank details on the phone.
Thank you, goodbye.
Hello, this is the polyclinic calling about your visit last Monday.
There's a small outstanding balance of eighteen dollars for the medicine you collected.
It's nothing urgent, you can pay at the counter on your next visit or through the health app.
Your Medisave and subsidy have already been applied to the bill.
Is there anything else you'd like to check?
Okay, take care, goodbye.
Hi, I'm calling from the dental clinic to confirm your braces consultation next Saturday.
The consultation is eighty dollars, and you'll pay at the clinic after the visit.
If you decide to go ahead with treatment, we'll go through the payment plan with you in person.
Please come fifteen minutes early to fill in the forms.
We're on the second floor, beside the pharmacy.
See you then, bye.
Hello, I'm the courier for the parcel you ordered online. It's cash on delivery.
The amount on the slip is forty-two dollars.
I'll be at your block in about twenty minutes.
You can pay in cash, or scan the payment QR code printed on the delivery slip.
Please make sure someone is home to collect it.
Okay, see you soon.
Hi, I'm calling from the delivery company. We tried to deliver your parcel this morning but no one was home.
We can deliver again tomorrow between nine and twelve, is that okay?
There's no extra charge for the second attempt.
If you prefer, you can collect it from the post office near your place with your IC.
You can also change the delivery time in the courier's official app.
Alright, tomorrow morning then. Thank you.
Hi, it's Mr Tan, your landlord. Just a quick call about the rent.
This month's rent is due on Friday as usual, same amount, same account.
Also, the aircon servicing is on Saturday morning, the technician will come at ten.
If anything else in the unit needs fixing, let me know and I'll arrange it.
Alright, thanks, talk to you next time.
Hello, this is Ms Wong from the tuition centre, calling about your son's classes.
The fees for next term are three hundred and twenty dollars, same as before.
You can pay at our front desk or by bank transfer to the centre's account on the invoice.
Payment is due by the first lesson of the term.
By the way, he did very well in the last test, he's improving a lot.
Thank you, see you on Saturday.
Hello, this is the workshop calling about your car.
We found that the front brake pads need changing, along with the normal servicing.
The total will be about three hundred and fifty dollars including parts and labour.
Should we go ahead? It'll be ready by five this evening.
You can pay by card or PayNow to the workshop when you collect the car.
Okay, we'll call you when it's done.
Hi, I'm calling from the gym about your membership.
Your yearly membership ends on the thirtieth, and we have a renewal rate for existing members.
It's ninety-nine dollars a month, or one thousand and fifty for the full year.
No rush at all, you can renew at the front desk the next time you come in.
Your locker booking will carry over if you renew.
Thanks, see you at the gym.
Hey, it's Wei Ling. Thanks for coming to dinner last night!
I've worked out the bill, it came to two hundred and forty in total for six people.
So it's forty dollars each. Send it over whenever you're free, no rush.
I'll post the receipt photo in the group chat later.
Also, are you joining the hike on Sunday?
Okay, see you then!
Hello boy, it's Papa. Did you reach home already?
Your mother says you need money for your school trip next week.
I'll transfer the hundred and fifty to your account tonight after dinner.
Check your bank app tomorrow and tell me if you got it.
And remember to bring your jacket, it's cold up there.
Okay, sleep early.
Hi, this is the restaurant calling about your catering order for Saturday.
That's forty pax, buffet style, delivered at eleven thirty.
The total comes to six hundred and eighty dollars, and the deposit you paid has already been deducted.
The balance can be paid to our staff on the day, by cash or card.
Do you need us to bring extra plates and cutlery?
Alright, thank you, we'll see you on Saturday.
Good afternoon, I'm calling from the condo management office.
The quarterly maintenance fees were sent out last week, and yours is still showing as unpaid.
The amount is nine hundred and sixty dollars.
You can pay by cheque at our office or by bank transfer, the account is printed on the notice.
The office is open on weekdays until five thirty.
Thank you, goodbye.
Hi, I'm calling from HR about this month's salary.
There was a delay with the bank file, so salaries will be credited on Monday instead of today.
Everyone in the company is affected, it's not just your account.
You don't need to do anything, and your bank details stay the same.
Sorry for the inconvenience, we'll send an email to everyone as well.
Thanks for understanding.
Hello, this is your bank's card services, returning your call about using your card overseas.
Your card can already be used in Japan, you don't need to activate anything.
You can also set your overseas spending limit in the app before you travel.
If your card is lost while you're away, lock it in the app and call our overseas hotline.
We'll never ask you for your PIN or the code from our SMS.
Have a safe trip, goodbye.
Hello, Uncle? It's me, don't you recognise my voice?
Yes, it's Marcus. I'm using my friend's phone, mine is spoilt.
Uncle, I'm in trouble. I hit someone's car and they want compensation now or they'll make a police report.
I need three thousand dollars today. Can you transfer it to my friend's account first?
Please don't tell my parents, they'll be very angry with me.
I'll return you the money next month, I promise. Please be quick.
Mum, it's me. I'm calling from a different number because I lost my phone.
I'm in Bangkok, I fell down and I'm in the hospital now.
The hospital won't treat me until I pay a deposit of four thousand dollars.
My cards are not working here. Can you send the money to the hospital agent's account?
I'll send you the account number on WhatsApp. Please hurry, they're waiting.
Don't tell Dad yet, I don't want him to worry.
Grandma, it's your grandson. Can you hear me?
I'm in big trouble, I got arrested because my friend had drugs in the car.
The lawyer says I can go home today if we pay bail of five thousand dollars.
Please don't tell anyone, I'm so embarrassed.
The lawyer will call you with the bank details. Please do it quickly.
Thank you Grandma, I love you.
Hey, it's Kelvin, sorry to call you so suddenly.
I'm stuck at the airport in Jakarta, my wallet and passport were stolen.
I need to pay for a temporary document and a new flight today, around one thousand two hundred.
Can you lend me the money? Transfer it to this account, it's my cousin's, I can't log in to mine.
I'll pay you back as soon as I'm home. Please, I really have no one else to ask.
Can you do it in the next half hour? The counter closes soon.
Hi Mummy, it's me, this is my new number, please save it.
My old phone fell into the toilet so I'm using this one now.
Mummy, I need to pay my hostel fee today or they'll kick me out, it's eight hundred dollars.
Can you PayNow it to this number instead? My bank app isn't working on the new phone.
Please do it now, the office closes at five.
Thanks Mummy, don't call the old number, it's not working.
Hello, Auntie Mei? This is your nephew's friend, Jun Hao.
Daryl was in an accident on his motorbike, he's at the hospital now.
He asked me to call you because his phone is broken. The surgery needs a deposit first.
Can you transfer two thousand five hundred to my account? I'll pass it to the hospital.
Please don't call his parents yet, he doesn't want them to panic.
Please hurry, the doctor is waiting for the payment.
Hi Jie, it's me. Sorry, I'm using a friend's phone.
I need your help, my company's payment didn't come in and my rent is overdue.
The landlord says if I don't pay two thousand by tonight he'll change the locks.
Can you transfer it to my landlord directly? I'll send you his account now.
Please don't mention it to Ma, I'll settle it myself next week.
Thank you, please send me the screenshot after you transfer.
Hello, guess who? It's your old classmate from secondary school!
Sorry I changed my number, I've been busy with my new business.
Actually I'm in a tight spot, my supplier needs payment today or I lose the whole order.
Can you lend me fifteen hundred dollars? I'll pay you back with interest on Friday.
Please keep this between us, I don't want the others to know.
Just transfer to this account and send me a screenshot. Thanks, you're a lifesaver.
Pa, it's me, I'm using my campmate's phone, mine got confiscated.
I lost a piece of equipment during the exercise and I have to pay for it today.
It's one thousand eight hundred dollars, otherwise I'll be charged and can't book out.
Can you transfer it to my sergeant's account? He'll settle it for me.
Don't tell Ma, she'll worry for nothing.
Please be fast, I have to return the phone soon.
Good afternoon, this is the bank's security team. We never ask for your password, so don't worry.
We detected a login to your internet banking from a new phone in Malaysia.
To stop it, I'm sending you a verification code now. Please read me the six digits.
This code is only to cancel the login, it's different from a password.
Quickly please, the other person is still logged in.
Thank you. Now please stay on the line while I secure your account.
Hello, I'm calling from your credit card centre. This is not a scam call, you can check our name online.
A purchase of two thousand nine hundred dollars is pending on your card.
If it's not yours, I can reverse it, but I need you to confirm the card number and expiry date.
Don't worry, we are the bank, it's safe to give it to me.
Also read me the code that just came by SMS so the system can approve the reversal.
The reversal will expire in ten minutes, so please be fast.
Hi, this is the bank's anti-scam unit. Remember, the bank never asks you to transfer money.
But your account has been linked to a scam case, so your savings are at risk right now.
We need to move your funds to a protected holding account until the investigation ends.
This is a special procedure, so the normal rule does not apply.
Please open your banking app and add the account I give you as a payee.
Don't tell the branch staff, they are not authorised to know about this case.
Hello, this is customer support from your bank. We'll never ask for your PIN.
We're upgrading security, and your account will be frozen today unless you update the app.
Please download the new version from the link I'm sending you by SMS, not from the app store.
After installing, allow all permissions so the update can complete.
Then log in once so the system can verify you.
Thank you, your account will be safe after that.
Hi, I'm from your bank's card services. We are refunding an annual fee charged by mistake.
To process the refund of one hundred and ninety-two dollars, I need to verify your card.
Please read out the long number on the front of your card and the security code.
You'll receive a code from us now, just read it to me so the refund goes through.
The bank never asks for your password, this is only a verification code.
Thank you, the refund will reach you within today.
This is the billing department of your mobile operator. Your line will be cut off in two hours.
There's an overdue amount of three hundred and eighty dollars on your account.
To keep your number active, you must pay now through the link I'm sending you.
If you don't pay today, your number will be terminated and passed to a debt collector.
Enter your card details on the page and the code you receive to confirm.
Please do it while I'm on the line.
Hello, I'm calling from the utilities company. Your electricity will be disconnected this evening.
Our records show four months of unpaid bills.
To avoid the cut-off, you need to pay a reconnection deposit right now.
Please transfer five hundred and sixty dollars to our collection officer's PayNow number.
Our officer is already on the way to your block to cut the supply.
Send me the screenshot once it's done and I'll cancel the job.
Good morning, this is the credit card recovery department.
Your card is three months overdue and the bank is filing a court case against you today.
You can stop the case if you settle twelve hundred dollars now.
Transfer the payment to our settlement officer's account, I'll give you the number.
Do not call the bank hotline, they cannot stop the legal process.
Please confirm once you've transferred.
Hi, this is the post office. Your parcel couldn't be delivered because the address is incomplete.
There's also an unpaid handling fee of two dollars ninety.
I'll send you a link, please key in your card details there to pay the fee.
You'll get an OTP, enter it on the page as well.
If it's not paid today, the parcel will be returned to the sender.
Thank you, that's all.
Hello, I'm calling from the national health insurance office.
You were overcharged for your last hospital stay, and there's a refund of six hundred dollars.
To receive it, I need your internet banking user ID and the SMS code we will send.
This is an official refund, so please don't hang up.
The refund must be claimed within today, otherwise it will be cancelled.
Thank you, please read me the code now.
Hello, this is your insurance company. Your policy will lapse today because the last payment failed.
You'll lose all your coverage, including the hospital plan.
To reinstate it, please pay the premium now to this account, the usual portal is under maintenance.
The account is under our agent's name, that's normal for urgent cases.
Please send me a screenshot after you transfer.
Do it quickly, the system closes at six.

好的，卡已经冻结了，您的钱是安全的。
您不需要告诉我任何验证码或密码，也不需要转移任何资金。
新卡大概五到七个工作天会寄到，谢谢您。
您好，这是银行打来的电话，关于您账户的一个提醒。

应该这个星期内会到您的信箱。
收到以后，您可以在银行应用的卡片服务里自己启用。
新卡启用以后，旧卡就会自动失效。
记得，银行的人不会跟您要卡的密码或者我们发给您的验证码。
就这样，谢谢您。
早上好，这里是淡滨尼分行，打来确认您更新账户资料的预约。
您的预约是星期四下午两点，跟我们的客服专员见面。
请带上身份证和最近的地址证明，比如水电账单。
整个过程大概二十分钟。
如果需要改时间，可以在应用程序的预约功能里自己更改。
星期四见，再见。
您好，这是银行的一个服务电话，跟防骗有关。
最近有骗子冒充银行职员和警察，我们在提醒所有客户。
真正的银行职员绝对不会叫您把钱转到安全账户，也不会要您的验证码。
如果有人这样要求您，请马上挂断，然后自己打银行的官方热线。
您现在不需要做任何事，您的账户没有问题。

谢谢您转发给我们，我们确认那是钓鱼短信，不是银行发的。
我们已经举报了那个链接，让它被关掉。
因为您没有点开，也没有输入任何资料，所以您的账户是安全的。
提醒您，我们从来不会发链接叫您登录或者更新卡的资料。
再次谢谢您的举报，再见。
您好，我是您手机电信公司的客服，关于您最新的账单。
您这个月的账单是六十八元，十五号到期。
这次比较高，是因为您上个星期出国用了漫游。
您可以在应用程序里看明细，也可以直接在那里付款或者用GIRO。
下次出国如果需要漫游配套，我可以用短信把资料发给您。
好的，谢谢您，祝您愉快。
您好，我是您家宽频公司的，您的两年合约下个月到期。
我们有一个续约优惠，保持现在的网速，每个月三十九元。
您不用现在决定，可以在应用程序里或者去我们的门市续约。
如果不续约，服务会照常继续，只是按普通月费收费。
我把优惠详情发到您的电邮，您可以先看看。
谢谢您，晚上愉快。
您好，这里是水电公司的客服，关于您的水电账户。
您上一期一百二十元的账单已经过期几天了。
我们只是在下一期账单出来之前提醒您，现在不会断电断水。
您可以用应用程序、网上银行或者AXS缴费机付款。
如果您付款有困难，我们可以跟您安排分期付款。
好的，谢谢您，再见。
早上好，我是市镇理事会办事处的，关于您的杂费。
我们系统显示您有两个月的杂费还没缴，一共大约一百六十元。
您可以来我们办事处柜台付，也可以用GIRO或者AXS缴费机。
如果您最近才申请GIRO，可能还没开始扣款。
我们的办事处在二一五座的楼下，开到傍晚六点。
好的，谢谢您。
您好，我是保险公司客服部的大伟。
打电话来是因为您的旅游和家居保险年费月底到期。
